Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 4 December. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges, and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

 

!! Please note: you do NOT qualify if you're not already living in Belgium (in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges) and don't have legal permission to work in the country !!

The offer

• You run steering committees and governance forums, and keep actions, risks, decisions and escalations firmly on track.
• Your management presentations and decision proposals shape where the program goes next.
• KPIs, forecasts and portfolio reporting come together with you, giving management one clear and reliable view of performance, trends and risks.
• Deep-dive analyses of processes, tools and ways of working, especially at Fiberklaar, reveal where things can be simpler, smarter and more automated.
• Turning those insights into reality is where you make the difference: you define better processes, tooling improvements and future operating models, and you help bring them to life.
• As the trusted link between operations and management, you align partners around shared goals and help a fast-growing fibre organisation become more efficient, scalable and industrialised.

Desired profile

• Experience in program management and/or business transformation
• A proven track record in process analysis and process improvement
• Experience with KPI reporting, performance tracking and governance
• Experience in telecom, network deployment, construction or fibre rollout is an asset
💡 Your skills

• You quickly find your way in complex operational environments and turn findings into concrete improvements.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills help you get to the root of issues.
• You build trust with stakeholders at every level and communicate with ease.
• You work comfortably in Dutch, French and English.
🌟 Who are you?

• A structured organiser with a hands-on, results-oriented mindset
• Someone who brings order and keeps moving things forward
• Passionate about operational excellence, digitalisation and automation

The offer

• Join one of Belgium’s largest fibre rollouts as the technical and operational reference point for MDU (multi-dwelling unit) files within the Build & Deployment team.
• Each MDU file assigned to you is your responsibility: you follow its technical progress through every deployment step, including Delay orders, preventive tickets and POB (Proof of Build) deliveries.
• Reliable information is your starting point: you check the consistency of plans and technical data and challenge them when they don’t match reality.
• Anomalies, risks and blockers don’t stay hidden for long: you analyse their root causes, define resolution actions and escalate what needs a decision or extra expertise.
• SSV and TSA teams can count on your technical support, from preparing field interventions to analysing feedback and following corrective actions through to closure.
• In the field and behind the screen, you connect what happens on site with engineering, design and the Build team, and you feed verified field data to the Data Analyst Build.
• Build management relies on your clear reporting on file status, key risks and open actions, which gives them the visibility they need to de-risk MDU activities.

Desired profile

• A technical background that lets you understand and analyse issues in the field
• The following are an asset:
• experience in telecommunications, FTTH, infrastructure deployment or a similar environment
• knowledge of the FTTH and MDU environment
• knowledge of SSV and TSA activities
💡 Your skills

• You read and interpret technical plans and documents with ease.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills help you get to the root of an issue, and you are comfortable working with data.
• You work fluently with office and reporting tools.
• You communicate clearly with both technical and operational stakeholders.
• You speak French fluently and have a professional level of English. 
🌟 Who are you?

• Just as comfortable with data and documentation as you are with field teams
• Rigorous, organised and autonomous in your follow-up
• Someone who takes ownership of an issue, from its identification through to its resolution or escalation

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English, spoken and written.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Funded under the Cyber Funded Research programme, the project adopts a phased, rigorous approach running from January 2027 to December 2030. Over the initial two-year period, it will establish a comprehensive technology landscape of quantum sensing across all major modalities (electromagnetic, gravitational, inertial, timing, and hybrid): analysing the state of the art, monitoring global innovation trajectories, mapping technology supply chains, assessing ruggedisation prospects, and characterising the likely evolution of each sensor class towards the 2030 horizon. Building upon this foundation and a formal evaluation and benchmarking framework, the project will then transition toward down-selection: identifying the candidate quantum sensors that could realistically be tested between 2030 and 2032 and that will form the basis for later prototyping, demonstration, and field trials. All findings will be consolidated into a strategic research and development roadmap (2030-2040) guiding infrastructure investments, skills development, and partnerships, and positioning the Royal Military Academy as a national competence centre for quantum sensing.

MAIN TASKS:

• Establishment and yearly update of a structured technology survey of quantum-sensor platforms (NV centres in diamond, Rydberg atoms, atom interferometers, trapped ions, atomic clocks, superconducting circuits), including TRL and maturity assessment and a mapping of the global research and industrial ecosystem.
• Mapping of classical sensor technologies to contextualise potential quantum advantages.
• Identification and prioritisation of defence-relevant use cases through capability-gap analysis, cross-domain applicability studies, and workshops with engineering, physics, and defence-research experts.
• Definition of evaluation criteria and benchmarking frameworks combining scientific performance metrics (sensitivity, stability, bandwidth, dynamic range, coherence time), engineering integration factors (SWaP-C, environmental robustness, system complexity), and manufacturability and lifecycle considerations.
• Feasibility studies and maturation pathways: identification of technological bottlenecks, modelling and simulation of sensor performance in relevant conditions, and estimation of development timelines.
• Down-selection of candidate quantum sensors for prototyping and demonstration in the 2030-2032 window, validated through workshops with domain experts.
• Development of a strategic research and development roadmap (2030-2040) addressing infrastructure, skills and training, and partnership opportunities.
• Project management and coordination: planning, progress monitoring, annual reporting, and review meetings.
• Participation in NATO and EDA working groups on quantum sensors.
• Attending and presenting at international conferences
• Writing scientific papers and project deliverables (technology survey reports, use case catalogue, evaluation framework, down-selection report, strategic roadmap). 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 

• Degree(s) required: PhD degree in a STEM field (Physics, Engineering Sciences, Applied Sciences, or a closely related discipline), preferably with a focus on quantum physics, photonics, or precision metrology.
• This is a senior researcher position: demonstrated experience in quantum technologies and in managing multidisciplinary research programmes is required (ideally 8 years of experience minimum).
 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Strong background in quantum physics, applied metrology, and advanced sensor technologies.
• Hands-on experimental expertise with laboratory setups involving atom-based sensors, photonics, or solid-state quantum devices.
• Proven track record of leading complex R&D projects and managing multidisciplinary research programmes.
• 
Ability to deliver high-quality scientific outputs relevant to engineering applications (peer-reviewed publications, technical reports).

 

 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:      

• Experience in supervising graduate students and mentoring junior researchers.
• Experience with international research collaborations (e.g., NATO STO or EDA working groups).
• Familiarity with technology readiness level (TRL) assessment, horizon scanning, and technology roadmapping.
• Experience with modelling, simulation, and data-processing approaches for the analysis and prediction of sensor performance.
• Knowledge of defence-relevant applications such as precision navigation and timing (PNT), electromagnetic spectrum awareness, or sensing in GNSS-denied environments.
 

Personal skills:

• You conduct scientific research in an independent and upright way within a multidisciplinary environment and communicate your results in a clear, concise and precise manner.
• You take initiative, solve problems autonomously and find alternatives or solutions.
• You are flexible for change and adapt yourself.
• You commit yourself in your job by giving the best of your aptitudes in striving toward the highest quality standards and persevere when needed.
 

Other skills:

• The applicant shall have good knowledge of English (oral / written).
• Minimum knowledge of French or Dutch is an added value for collaboration with peers.
• Good communication abilities to participate and engage with various end-users.
 

Specific Requirements

• The researcher will be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defence.
• Only applicants with a nationality of a country that is part of NATO will be eligible.

jobs.occupation: PhD Researcher (M/F/X) Mathematics department > SMAC Unit Project: POSEIDON-NG M/W/X
jobs.description:
PROJECT:You will work within the SMAC Unit (Simulation, Modelling, and Analysis of Complex Systems) of the department of Mathematics of the RMA and in close collaboration with the Belgian and Dutch Navies. You will conduct scientific research at university level, leading to a PhD degree, on a project entitled POSEIDON-NG.The project aims to develop a next-generation, uncertainty-aware scheduling capability (computer implementation) to assess, plan, and optimise Mine Countermeasure (MCM) missions carried out by unmanned systems. Responding to Belgium's transition to standoff, drone-centric MCM operations under the Belgian-Dutch rMCM programme, the computer implementation must coordinate multiple unmanned surface, underwater, and aerial vehicles simultaneously, quantify and manage mission uncertainty (e.g., variable detection rates, timing variance, weather windows), generate efficient task sequences and routes, and adapt plans quickly as situational data evolves. The new POSEIDON-NG engine will serve as an advanced decision-support tool for the Belgian and Dutch Navies, providing reliable, conflict-free, risk-informed mission plans, rapid replanning, and operator-oriented features such as what-if (sensitivity) analysis and clear plan-quality indicators. The resulting capabilities will improve the planning, safety, tempo, and overall effectiveness of MCM operations and support the introduction of the new autonomous MCM fleet.

This work builds on prior RMA research funded by Belgian Defence. The DAP/22-14 project (SBOS for MCM) delivered the POSEIDON prototype, a two-level mission-planning engine: a low-level module computes detailed vehicle trajectories, sensor-informed detection performance, and the corresponding execution times, while a high-level module uses this information to schedule tasks, allocate vehicles, and coordinate routes across the entire mission using combinatorial optimisation based on Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP). The prototype also established graph-based shortest-path computation between mine zones, automated generation of mine-threat areas, and a practical operator interface to configure mission parameters and visualise plans. The proposed research will extend this foundation with uncertainty quantification, a bidirectional planning loop enabling rapid replanning, scalable optimisation methods (decomposition, heuristics, hybrid solvers), and exploratory quantum(-inspired) optimisation, transforming a promising prototype into an uncertainty-aware, scalable, and deployment-ready operational tool.

MAIN TASKS:Extension of the existing MILP-based scheduling formulation with uncertainty-aware constructs (robust, stochastic, or chance-constrained formulations).Development of a bidirectional coupling between the low-level trajectory and risk models and the high-level scheduler, enabling rapid mission replanning.Improvement of the scalability of the scheduling engine through MILP decomposition, heuristics and metaheuristics, and hybrid solver designs.Exploration of quantum and quantum-inspired optimisation methods (QUBO, QAOA, annealing-inspired heuristics) for selected combinatorial subproblems.Integration of all developments into the two-level POSEIDON-NG architecture and extension of the Graphical User Interface with operator-focused features (what-if analysis, plan-quality indicators).End-user engagement: definition and validation of representative MCM scenarios together with Belgian and Dutch Navy operators.Use best practices for code development and documentation.Attending and presenting at international conferencesWriting scientific papers and a PhD thesis.
 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:Degree(s) required: Master's degree in a STEM field (Engineering, Applied Sciences, Physics, Computer Science, or Mathematics).This is a 5-year PhD position: recent Master's graduates are encouraged to apply; prior experience in optimisation or modelling and simulation is an asset.

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:1.Background in mathematical optimisation. Ideally with Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) and combinatorial optimisation.2.Experience in programming with Julia, C++ or Python.3.Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases.

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:1.Knowledge of uncertainty quantification and stochastic or robust optimisation.2.Experience with MILP solvers, decomposition techniques (e.g., Benders decomposition, column generation) or metaheuristics (e.g., GRASP).3.Affinity with quantum computing and quantum optimisation (QUBO formulations, QAOA, quantum annealing).4.Knowledge of the maritime domain, naval mine countermeasures, or unmanned systems (USV/UUV/AUV).5.Collaboration in Software Development (GitHub)

Personal skills:You conduct scientific research in an independent and upright way within a multidisciplinary environment and communicate your results in a clear, concise and precise manner.You take initiative, solve problems autonomously and find alternatives or solutions.You are flexible for change and adapt yourself.You commit yourself in your job by giving the best of your aptitudes in striving toward the highest quality standards and persevere when needed.

Robert Half is currently looking for an Office & Management Assistant (m/f/x).

The company is located in Brussels and this is a full-time position within an architecture and consulting environment.

 

You will join a growing, close-knit organisation of approximately 25 independent professionals, mainly architects. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the organisation.

 

This is not a traditional secretarial position. The company is looking for a versatile, hands-on and proactive individual who can take ownership of the operational and administrative management of the office, ranging from financial administration and project follow-up to coordinating external service providers.

 

You will work closely with management, gradually taking over a number of operational and administrative responsibilities. As the organisation continues to grow, you will have the opportunity to expand your responsibilities and develop towards a fully-fledged Office Manager position.

 

The responsibilities of this position as Office & Management Assistant are:

• You ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the office and oversee the general management of its facilities and services.
• You coordinate external service providers, including cleaning services, suppliers and delivery companies.
• You handle the administrative follow-up of clients, suppliers and various operational requests.
• You manage invoicing, including through Peppol and other digital platforms, and ensure the follow-up of outstanding customer and supplier invoices (approximately 300 invoices per year).
• You monitor payments, expense claims and professional expenses.
• You maintain contact with the external accounting firm and provide support with accounting and tax-related processes.
• You contribute to the financial and budgetary follow-up of approximately 50 to 60 projects running simultaneously.
• You monitor registered working hours and hourly rates to ensure accurate project invoicing.
• You prepare Excel reports, financial overviews and various management dashboards.
• You manage and update administrative information relating to projects and independent professionals.
• You actively identify opportunities to optimise internal processes through IT tools, management software and the automation of administrative tasks.
• You contribute to structuring and improving internal administrative procedures as the organisation continues to grow.
• You provide direct operational and organisational support to management.

The required qualifications for this position as Office & Management Assistant are:

• You have a first relevant experience in an administrative position, Office Management or Management Assistance. Motivated recent graduates are also encouraged to apply.
• You hold a degree in Business Management, IT, Software, Administration or an equivalent field.
• You have an excellent command of Dutch, French and English, both spoken and written. English is the main working language within the office.
• You have a strong affinity with figures, accounting, invoicing and financial processes.
• You have a good knowledge of Excel and are comfortable working with IT tools and management software.
• You are particularly interested in new technologies, digitalisation and process optimisation.
• You are well organised, accurate and able to manage several projects and priorities simultaneously.
• You are proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented, with a strong sense of initiative.
• You enjoy working independently while being a genuine team player.
• You feel comfortable in a small, dynamic working environment where you can take ownership and have a direct impact on the organisation.

About Us: Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

Job Description & Key ResponsibilitiesAs a OPEX engineer you will drive the continuous improvement culture within the production facility. In this role you will look beyond the surface, diving deep into the process to eliminate waste and scale manufacturing efficiency to the next level.
 

We’re looking for an energetic and enthusiastic personality with excellent communication skills, capable of inspiring and engaging teams to bring meaningful change and challenge the status quo, while respecting strict quality and safety.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 

• Process Optimization: you are responsible for identifying, implementing, and ensuring process improvements to increase efficiency, quality, and safety. 

• Follow-up on KPI’s; apply value stream mapping and execute Gemba walks. 

• Based on data driven analysis, you identify hidden opportunities and propose improvements. 

• Lead independently cross functional improvement projects with minimal supervision. 

• Standardization & training: write, revise, and standardize Standard Operating Procedures to embed new best practices firmly into daily operations; deliver training modules to build a site-wide OPEX mindset. Responsible for keeping training matrix up-to-date and organizing training accordingly, in collaboration with the production team lead. 

• Identify root causes of technical anomalies/malfunctions or inefficiencies. 

• Provide support with day-to-day technical problems; act as a point of contact for problem solving. 

• Support implementation of new equipment, systems or workflows. 

The role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, preventive way of thinking, a high degree of independence, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team. 
 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• A master’s degree in engineering/biotech with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a continuous Improvement or OPEX role within a manufacturing environment; 

• Proven track record of applying operational excellence techniques as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) in a production setting. 

• Analytical and data-driven, out-of-the-box thinking, solution-oriented mindset, and a hands-on approach. 

• Experience in biochemical process know-how and change-management is a plus. 

• A structured way of working, with an eye of detail, excellent communicator able to engage people, with a drive for continuous improvement. 

• Fluency in English, both verbal and written; fluency in Dutch is a plus.
